# Baselayer Workspace

> Offline, DAG-routed documentation workspace: baselayer + curated
> agent skills + agent runtime layer. Python 3 stdlib only, no build
> dependencies.

## Router (agents read this first)

- AGENTS.md: entry router — protocol, token budget, build commands.
- .context/manifest.json: generated routing table (docs DAG).
- .context/index.md: plain fallback index.

## Docs (baselayer-indexed via .context/graph.json)

- docs/resources/README.md: skills archive provenance, trust tiers.
- docs/resources/project-management.md: PM skills shortlist.

## Skills

- .harness/skills/: 57 curated skills — canonical SKILL.md per skill.
- skills/index.json: slim router (name + description + path only).
- .archive/Agentsandskills/: raw archive (686M, NOT indexed, gitignored).

## Agent layer

- .agent/README.md: agent runtime design (resources, tools, MCP).
- .agent/mcp/server.py: MCP server (compile_context, read_section).
- .agent/tools/context.py: context core (CLI + importable).
- .agent/.env: keys (gitignored); template: .agent/.env.example.

## Build (order matters)

```
python3 seed.py     # docs/ -> .context/graph.json
python3 build.py    # graph.json -> manifest.json + wiki/index.html
python3 .harness/gen_skills_index.py   # after skill changes
```

## Stages (ICM)

- 01-navigate/ → 02-plan/ → 03-execute/ → 04-verify/
- memory/learnings.md: persistent learnings appended after each session.
